### D1.1 Project KPIs — attainment against target
**⚠ SIMULATED DATA.** No real KIO module reports these yet; every value below is generated by `kio-simulator/kio_simulator.py` within D1.1's baseline/target bands. These are *not* project results. Real values will arrive tagged `source=real` as KIO owners connect.

panels.title: D1.1 KPIs — current value (all KIOs, SIMULATED)
panels.description: One bar per KPI, KPI name on the left. Shows the real measured number right now, in D1.1's own unit (mostly "% of baseline" — 100% means no improvement yet over the old way of working). Bar color: green = KPI target met, orange = close, red = not met.

panels.title: D1.1 KPIs over time — green = baseline (100%), red = target (all KIOs, SIMULATED)
panels.description: Same KPIs as the bar chart above, as a trend line instead of a single number, so you can see if a KPI is getting better or worse over time. Two reference lines per KPI, straight from D1.1 Table 8 (docs/report/KPI_Metrik_Referansi_v1.3.docx): green = baseline (the old, pre-AI way of working — 100% for most KPIs, 0% for the three adoption-style KPIs 8.1/8.2/8.3 which start at zero), red = the D1.1 target. Above the green line but below red = improving, not there yet; past the red line = target met. Click a KPI's name in the legend below the chart to isolate just that one line and its own two reference lines — note the different KPIs use different raw units (mostly "% of baseline", but tokens/s/W, MOS 1-5, and a 0/1 count for three of them), so isolating one KPI at a time reads more cleanly than all 17 together on one shared axis.

targets.expr: count(count by (kio_id) (increase(kio_heartbeat[5m]) > bool 0 == 1)) or count(count by (kio_id)(kio_heartbeat))

panels.title: Total LLM cost (USD)
panels.description: Cumulative total since process start (not a rate) — it keeps growing, so a green/yellow/red health threshold isn't meaningful; deliberately left neutral (blue).

panels.title: Energy (kJ, all)
panels.description: Cumulative total since process start (not a rate) — it keeps growing, so a green/yellow/red health threshold isn't meaningful; deliberately left neutral (blue).

panels.title: Time since last heartbeat (seconds)
panels.description: Every KIO must publish a heartbeat every 60s (Contract §2.3). Values exceeding 120s (2x the interval) turn red — see the 'Stale KIO' alert rule in grafana/provisioning/alerting/rules.yml, which fires on the same threshold in the Alerting tab.
